purpose: VRChat social / bar / cafe / academic presentation / DJ venue
coordinate_system: Origin (0,0) = southwest outer corner. +X east, +Y north, +Z up.

zones_1f.name: Entrance / Orientation
zones_1f.notes: Spawn buffer, world rules, event status, coat/prop shelf.

zones_1f.name: Main Bar
zones_1f.notes: Primary conversation anchor. Counter approx. 11.5 m total usable edge.

zones_1f.name: Cafe / Low Social
zones_1f.notes: 2-4 person tables, lower voice intensity, visible from entrance.

zones_1f.name: Main Social Lounge
zones_1f.notes: Modular lounge seating; converts to academic audience or standing DJ floor.

zones_1f.name: Central Stage
zones_1f.notes: Academic talks, panel, live performance. 250 mm platform.

zones_1f.name: Main Media Wall
zones_1f.notes: 16:9 presentation surface, effective screen 7.1 x 4.0 m in 3D wall.

zones_1f.name: Poster / Demo Gallery
zones_1f.notes: Six poster bays + four demo plinths. Stand-off circulation 1.5 m.

zones_1f.name: Quiet Nook
zones_1f.notes: Semi-open acoustic refuge; full Quiet Room is on 2F.

zones_1f.name: Main Social Stair
zones_1f.notes: 1.5 m clear visual stair; use simplified/ramp collider for VR locomotion.

zones_1f.name: Back of House / AV
zones_1f.notes: AV rack, prop storage, staff-only dressing, hidden maintenance.

zones_2f.name: Suspended DJ Booth
zones_2f.notes: Faces main lounge; academic mode dims/folds visual effects.

zones_2f.name: City Terrace / Overlook
zones_2f.notes: Window-side skyline lounge; calm social node.

zones_2f.name: Quiet Room
zones_2f.notes: Closed 4-8 person discussion room, low BGM, warm lighting.

zones_2f.name: South Bridge / Balcony
zones_2f.notes: Connects mezzanine sides, gives stage overview.

circulation.virtual_accessibility: Provide optional elevator/teleport and/or invisible gentle-ramp collider. Never force precision stair climbing.

style: Dark neo-industrial + warm hospitality + flat-light stylization + restrained neon
design_rule: Small enough for social proximity; vertically layered so different participation intensities coexist without fragmenting the room.

implementation_extensions.notes: Cafe and FPV retained. Original enclosed neon switchyard: 34 tight corners across three levels, defined in kart_circuit.json. CVS2 vehicles are installed separately by the owner.
